name: Bootstrap Icons
description: Registers the Bootstrap Icons SVG library (2000+ icons) as a Drupal core Icon API pack via the built-in svg extractor.
project_description: Integrates the Bootstrap Icons library with Drupal's Icon API (11.1+), registering 2000+ free, MIT-licensed SVG icons as a discoverable icon pack with no JavaScript runtime. The module ships a single icons.yml definition that points core's built-in `svg` extractor at `/libraries/bootstrap-icons/icons/*.svg` and a Twig template wrapping each icon's SVG content in the canonical `class="bi bi-..."` markup with a configurable pixel size. The vendored SVG library is installed separately, either with the module's `drush bootstrap_icons:download` command or via the shipped `composer.libraries.json` fragment. No routes, permissions, config entities, or content types are added; icons are rendered server-side through the standard `#type => icon` render element and the `icon()` Twig function.
